definitions: Past tense of squat: crouched down with your knees bent and your bottom very close to your heels.
Past tense of squat: occupied an unused building or land illegally.
Past tense of squat: (of an animal) sat or lay with its body close to the ground.
examples: He squatted by the fire to warm his hands.
They squatted in the abandoned house for months.
The dog squatted down, ready to pounce.
